status: monitoring thresholds, not a trading rule; commit before the first sweep; any change is a new id; no order, cancel or position call

measures.overnight_shares: BOATS snapshot dailyBar.v, only when the UTC date of dailyBar.t equals trade_date; prevDailyBar (the previous overnight session) is never used
measures.overnight_dollar_volume: dailyBar.v * dailyBar.vw (approximate: vw excludes trades that do not update high/low, e.g. odd lots)
measures.adv20_shares: mean SIP 1Day v over the last 20 regular sessions before trade_date, split-adjusted (monitor.AdvLoader formula)
measures.ref_close: SIP 1Day c of the prior regular session (2026-09-28)
measures.relvol_boats20: overnight_shares / (sum of BOATS 1Day v over the 20 SIP trade dates before trade_date / 20); a date without a BOATS bar counts as 0
measures.prior_sessions: number of those 20 trade dates with a BOATS 1Day bar

alerts.jsonl: alerts.jsonl and top.jsonl in --out, always written
alerts.ntfy: best effort; a failed post is recorded and never stops a sweep

calibration.note: full-session totals on the five nights before tonight (BOATS trade dates 2026-09-22, 09-23, 09-24, 09-25, 09-28), read 2026-09-28 about 21:20 ET from BOATS and SIP 1Day bars for 9,683 overnight_tradable names; relvol baseline approximated by the last 20 BOATS bars; fund tag from monitor.FUND_NAME on asset names (misses some ETFs, e.g. QLD)
